rows.text: The Ministry of Welfare's resolution No. 1/3/91-CC.I of 14 February 1992, reconstituting the National Committee for Centenary Celebrations of Baba Saheb Dr. B.R. Ambedkar, lists as member 117 'Shri S.R. Bommai, President Janata Dal, No. 7, Jantar Mantar Road, New Delhi'.
